description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Partners for Residential Property Sales
 
Are delighted to present to you for sale No. 36 The Waterfront, on the banks of the River Corrib in the heart of the historical centre of Galway city.

Once known as the River Gaillimh or ‘Stony River’ this is the birthplace of Galway City where Tuam's High King of Ireland Turlough O Connor founded his fort these very banks in 1152. To this day the location remains the cultural  and historical epicentre of Galway City.

From your front door, a gentle riverside stroll brings you directly into the cobbled streets of the Latin Quarter, the cultural heartbeat of Galway, alive with award-winning restaurants, traditional music, artisan cafés, theatres, galleries and a nightlife scene that gives the city its unmistakable atmosphere. 

Landmarks such as the Spanish Arch are moments away, placing you right at the epicentre of everything that makes Galway one of Europe’s most vibrant and distinctive cities.

No. 36 is a spacious ground-floor, three-bedroom apartment extending to over 87 square meters, offering three generous double bedrooms together with a bright open-plan kitchen, dining and living space designed for comfortable modern city living.

The ground-floor setting enhances accessibility and creates a unique connection to the riverside environment, where the calming presence of the Corrib forms part of everyday life.

This is a rare opportunity for you to acquire a substantial three-bedroom residence within the cultural and historical core of Galway City. 

Waterfront properties such as this seldom come to market, particularly one with such immediate access to the heart of the city.

Call us today to arrange your viewing visit.

Brought to you by Fair Deal Property Where Ethical Standards Meet Performance-led Outcomes.
